catalog_title: Freely Available Open Climate & Worker Datasets
description: Exhaustive registry of open-access public meteorological, satellite, and labour datasets ingested by HeatSutra.

datasets.name: Copernicus ERA5-Land Climate Reanalysis
datasets.api_access: Open-Meteo Historical Archive / Copernicus CDS API (No API key required)
datasets.role_in_engine: Forms the 35-year historical backbone (1991–2025; 12,784 records/city) to calculate Stull wet-bulb, burning costs, and empirical payout frequency.

datasets.name: IMD Pune Gridded Daily Temperature Records
datasets.institution: India Meteorological Department (IMD) / Ministry of Earth Sciences
datasets.api_access: IMD Pune CMPG Archive & Python imdlib package
datasets.role_in_engine: Ground-truth meteorological baseline used to audit station-to-reanalysis discrepancy and basis risk in Data Trust.

datasets.name: NASA POWER Agroclimatology & Solar Radiation
datasets.license: NASA Public Domain / Unrestricted Open Data
datasets.api_access: NASA POWER REST API (Free, rate-limit friendly)
datasets.role_in_engine: Provides solar radiation insolation data to evaluate direct radiant heat loads on unshaded informal construction workers.

datasets.name: e-Shram National Unorganised Worker Database
datasets.institution: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
datasets.api_access: e-Shram Public Analytics Dashboard & MoLE Portal
datasets.role_in_engine: Calibrates cohort sizing, daily wage benchmarks (₹350–₹500/day), and UPI payment delivery channels across 16 pilot cities.

datasets.name: MHT & SEWA Slum Microclimate Logger Telemetry
datasets.api_access: MHT Climate Resilience Research Publications & NRDC Reports
datasets.role_in_engine: Provides empirical evidence that informal tin-roof homes run +3.5°C to +5.2°C hotter than airport thermometers, justifying lowered trigger thresholds.

datasets.name: ISRO Bhuvan & Landsat-8/9 Urban Heat Island (UHI) Index
datasets.institution: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) / ISRO & USGS
datasets.license: ISRO Bhuvan Open Data / USGS Public Domain
datasets.role_in_engine: Calculates ward-level thermal anomaly offsets to correct airport weather station basis risk for informal settlement neighborhoods.

datasets.name: Lancet Countdown Heat-Health & Labor Loss Coefficients
datasets.institution: Lancet Countdown on Health and Climate Change
datasets.role_in_engine: Provides the physiological labor productivity curve: 2.5% loss per 1.0°C WBGT above 20.0°C.

datasets.name: NDMA National Heat Wave Management Framework
datasets.institution: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Govt of India
datasets.role_in_engine: Aligns HeatSutra operational triggers with municipal Heat Action Plan alert protocols and inter-departmental checklists.

sample_record.action_required: Activate municipal cooling centres, suspend outdoor work 12-4 PM, initiate relief cash disbursement
